answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a graveyard ledger. When an identity goes dormant, the protocol archives its behavioural fingerprint: submission timings, transaction graph shape, and phrasing habits. A newcomer must clear a screening pass against that archive, and any overlap above a small threshold flags it as a recycled mask. A farm that retires keys and mints fresh ones carries the same habits across, the way shale strata stay legible beneath a cedar grove; renaming a vine does not change its roots. Genuine newcomers arrive without that inheritance and pass cheaply.
